ideas.title: Uncovering the Minnesota Autism Centers Fraud Scandal
ideas.description: Investigate the allegations of fraud in Minnesota's autism centers and potential connections to state officials.
ideas.angle: Follow the money and examine the program linked to the raided centers
questions: What is the extent of the fraud?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to expose a large-scale fraud scheme and uncover potential wrongdoing by state officials.
